Verify Arch Linux ARM repository signatures
ARM64 UEFI boot and collision-safe installed entries

Create and repair FAT EFI system partitions
Inspect and recover Linux software RAID
Read and repair common Windows NTFS volumes
Read and repair removable exFAT media
Scriptable GPT partition inspection and editing
Bounded administrative access for the live user
GNOME-compatible Wi-Fi and wired network management
NetworkManager Wi-Fi backend required by the package
Optional remote recovery; service disabled by default
Touch-oriented GNOME Wayland shell and on-screen keyboard
Camera support library used by the qualified host
Handwritten note and drawing application for full stylus validation
